note: Closed table maintained by the content team (contract §13.6, §16.1, §30.7d): which craft-directive nodes of content/craft/text-graph.json the capsule's `style.directives` carries for each Director beat, plus one English line for each of the six style axes and the four directives (the keeper carries them into the player's language; `language_applicability` on the text-graph nodes stays data). Every id must exist in the text graph; the kernel validates this at load and never judges prose to pick a line. On 2026-09-24 (contract §30.7d) the eleven per-rewrite-lane directives were retired for four exchange-coherence directives, so every beat now carries the same four in one order: the unit of work is this exchange, and gesture, voice or detail are choices inside it, not per-beat obligations. `floor_lines` (2026-09-11, docs/specs/turn-floor.md) are the four content kinds every turn owes, carried as `style.floor` on every turn regardless of beat; they are lines, not counts, and the kernel never judges prose against them.

axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-translationese: write natural, complete sentences with clear speakers and relationships
axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-ai-summary-voice: give the exchange its next meaningful response or settled consequence
axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-log-style-summary: choose scene detail for what the player is doing and can perceive
axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-semantic-repetition: let established NPC intentions and relationships shape their wording and register
axis_lines.style-axis:avoid-abstract-psychological-: vary focus and rhythm with the scene; plain answers, narration, dialogue and purposeful silence are all available
axis_lines.style-axis:prefer-observable-behavior: preserve source truth, player agency and the actual settled outcome

directive_lines.exchange-response: start from the world's uptake of the declaration; a necessary bridge is not a replay of the player's whole input
directive_lines.voice-with-purpose: let each relevant speaker answer, ask, offer, evade or refuse from their established position; their words can carry the beat without a compulsory gesture
directive_lines.selective-detail: make the relevant person, object or space intelligible; choose details that change perception or meaning rather than filling a sensory or atmosphere quota
directive_lines.clarity-and-completion: carry the settled result to its actual endpoint; reread for clear agency, speaker transitions and natural play_language

brief_directive_lines.exchange-response: Answer the declaration through the world, not a replay.
brief_directive_lines.voice-with-purpose: Let established voices answer; gestures are optional.
brief_directive_lines.selective-detail: Choose relevant detail, not a sensory or atmosphere quota.
brief_directive_lines.clarity-and-completion: Complete the settled result; keep agency and speakers clear.

floor_lines: uptake: make clear how the world receives the player's chosen action or words without requiring the whole declaration to be spoken or performed twice
answer: show the actual settled result and answer the selected exchange; quiet play needs no new event and an offer is not a debt
voice: use the touched person's own speech or meaningful silence; preserve who said what and who knows what
handoff: complete the selected goal or stop at a genuinely new unselected consequential decision, with enough public context to judge
